newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Demand up on Bulgaria depo mkt on T-paper payments.
newsitem.headline: Demand up on Bulgaria depo mkt on T-paper payments.

text.p: Demand for Bulgarian interbank lev deposits rose on Wednesday due to treasury paper settlement payments but supply was high enough and rates were unchanged from Tuesday, dealers said.
"Demand for short-term deposits rose as banks had to pay for the treasury bills they bought on Monday," a bank dealer said.
On Monday banks bought two discount T-bill issues with maturities of three and 12 months respectively and a total par value of 12 billion levs.
Interbank overnight lev depo rates stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually, flat from Tuesday. Spot week lev rates were also unchanged at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 1.79 percent on Tuesday, up from 1.93 percent on Monday, a central bank official said.
The central bank main lev interest rate is now set at 5.50 percent, up from from 5.42 percent last week. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
